subjectPolicy: verified internal subject must be svc:-prefixed and bounded; provider identity provisioning remains a deployment responsibility

signature.secret: NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_SIGNING_SECRET is the active key; optional NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_SIGNING_SECRET_PREVIOUS and comma-separated NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_SIGNING_SECRETS support bounded rotation; every accepted key is 32..256 non-whitespace bytes and no valid key fails closed

request.payload: provider-specific object retained for reconciliation; recipient and message data are never logged
request.jobResolution: job_id is preferred when supplied; otherwise provider_message_id is matched against the durable channel-job provider ID inside the event transaction
request.eventTime: occurred_at is retained when present and otherwise the service receipt time is used for the linked notification sent_at

success.durability: provider and provider_event_id are unique; a first event is stored transactionally and reconciles the referenced channel job by internal job_id or persisted provider_message_id, plus its linked pending notification

stateMapping.terminalOrAcceptedJobs: dead_lettered, terminal_failed, and provider_accepted states are never overwritten by a conflicting provider event
